# Test fixture models

Sample glTF binaries from the Khronos glTF-Sample-Assets repository, used only by the asset-import tests.

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `Duck.glb` | https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/Duck | CC-BY 3.0 (Sony) |
| `Fox.glb` | https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/Fox | CC-BY 4.0 (PixelMannen / tomkranis) — includes skinned animations |
| `BoxTextured.glb` | https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/BoxTextured | CC-BY 4.0 (Khronos) |

Not shipped with the engine; test-only.
